run_acute_eval_analysis: run the ACUTE-Eval analyzer on a single run ID to extract and analyze crowdsourcing evaluation results
analyze_multi_run_acute_eval: analyze multiple ACUTE-Eval runs simultaneously by combining results from different run IDs into a single analysis
get_win_fractions: get the win fractions dataframe showing pairwise model comparison results sorted by win percentage
get_matchup_significance: get matchup totals with statistical significance using binomial tests to determine if model differences are significant
save_acute_eval_results: save ACUTE-Eval analysis results including significance data, win fraction grids, and conversation visualizations to CSV and HTML files
